name: try-museum
title: Museum
description: Find public domain artworks by color. Browse palettes, copy images, and discover art from museum collections.
author: ray.dhruv

commands.name: find-art-by-color
commands.title: Search Art by Color
commands.description: Find artworks using a hex value, CSS color name, RGB, or HSL color

commands.name: search-art-from-clipboard
commands.title: Search Art from Clipboard or Selection
commands.description: Find art matching the color in selected text, falling back to the clipboard

commands.name: pick-color-from-screen
commands.title: Pick Color from Screen
commands.description: Pick a screen color with the Color Picker extension and find matching art

commands.name: random-artwork
commands.title: Random Artwork
commands.description: Discover a random public domain artwork and its palette

tools.name: search-artworks
tools.title: Search Artworks
tools.description: Find public domain art by CSS color, ranked using Museum color matching.

tools.name: get-artwork-palette
tools.title: Get Artwork Palette
tools.description: Get an artwork and its palette by exact catalog ID returned from search-artworks.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: resultCount
preferences.title: Result Count
preferences.description: Maximum artworks shown in color searches

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action
preferences.description: Action performed when you press Enter on an artwork

preferences.name: wallpaperScreen
preferences.title: Wallpaper Screens
preferences.description: On macOS, set wallpaper on all screens or the screen containing the pointer

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Catalog Refresh Interval
preferences.description: How often to check Museum for catalog changes. Use Refresh Catalog to check immediately.
